purpose: Check exact presentation edition versus primary annotation timestamps, without fitting a scanner offset
selection: Published segment/scene starts near beginning, middle and end, fixed before media probing; retain every selected landmark, failures and residuals. The coarse and fine annotations differ by up to 3s per authors.
probe: Seek each exact media part to landmark minus 3 seconds, decode 6 second window; nearest FFmpeg scene score >0.3 cut. Decode visual frames around retained failures if needed; cuts support media-edition correspondence only, not scanner triggers.
acceptance: No optimized offset. Report signed residuals and broad-window ambiguity; annotation seconds remain a published convention, scanner physical onset inference remains conditional absent recording trigger.
